title: Kusanagi Nene — Who We Want To Be〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!

rows.Line: Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Great practice today, you guys☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Nice work.
I think we learned a lot today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! But as educational as each practice with Shunmeiza is, they do take their toll...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially since the play for newcomers ended. I feel like their practices have become much more demanding...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We were working with mostly the younger members before... But now, we're getting to practice with the veterans from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Those improv skits we did today also felt a little different. The outer space theme they chose was very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Those improv skits...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was just thinking that the improv skits we did today were pretty hard.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The prompt was difficult, but also intriguing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A story about six people stranded in space due to their ship running out of fuel and needing to work together in order to get back to Earth...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But how that story unfolded depended on each group's interpretation!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And yours actually made it back to Earth, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. We managed to figure out a way to shoot our high-energy cannon in the opposite direction of where we were drifting, which put us on a trajectory back towards Earth!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be honest, I wasn't fully able to follow the others when they were explaining the physics behind our plan...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My group ended up fighting over what precious little oxygen we had left. Ultimately, we all perished out in space.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, us too!
Our cryogenic sleep pods ended up breaking, and we were all mummified by the time we got back.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My group also faced the same fate...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
Which makes me the sole survivor!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It doesn't matter whether or not you survived since we were there to practice acting...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, I probably shouldn't talk considering how awful my acting was...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? You thought you did that poorly?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, I got an earful at the end about how the audience wouldn't understand what I was feeling because I was so unexpressive.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, was that in reference to that one scene...?
When you all panicked after realizing that your ship was malfunctioning?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I should have been the most emotional since I was the youngest member of the crew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I had trouble sounding hysterical, which ended up affecting the performance of the other members of my group...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I feel really bad about holding us back.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I understand how you feel. The things I need to work on keep increasing with each performance we do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Exactly...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I knew this was bound to happen after hearing that we'd be working with Shunmeiza...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(They're so good, and I'm not...
My acting skills just pale in comparison.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're not about to give up, are we?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, we aren't.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In order to keep growing as actors, we need to keep pushing each other and making the most of these practices!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. And we're not about to let them have all the fun, are we?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nope! I'm also gonna keep learning lots and lots!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah! We're back in high spirits now! So, let's head over to SEKAI and do some more improv practice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, now...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, you're right. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I honestly couldn't feel more blessed.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Not only do I get to see professional actors work up close, I'm acting right there with them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which is why I need to make the most of this time. I have to learn as much as I possibly can from them. And then...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And then someday, I'll become a world-class musical actress. Just like Ms. Kazamatsuri...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've gotta keep growing!)
